summary: For a Tourist on Home level 4, JavaScript computes the role-specific Tou-filb quest filler name but has no loader entry, so generation falls through to the ordinary maze path instead of loading dat/Tou-filb.lua. source.branch: When mklev.c:makelevel() creates a Tourist quest filler at or below the locate level, it forms Tou-filb and mkmaze.c:makemaz() loads the complete special-level program. Tou-filb.lua runs solidfill, mazelevel/noflip, a smoothed joined/walled Mines background, up/down stairs, eleven random objects, four random traps, one hostile soldier, two hostile captains, two hostile class-H monsters, one hostile class-C monster, and one random spider-class monster, in source order.
callers: mklev.c:makelevel() -> mkmaze.c:makemaz() -> sp_lev.c:load_special() -> dat/Tou-filb.lua top-level statements.
js/mklev.js:760-772 computes the role-specific filler name and calls makemaz() only when SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS contains Tou-filb.
dependencies: The registered special-level path already runs dat/nhlib.lua alignment initialization before the program body.
All level descriptors in Tou-filb.lua use the existing des API.
